To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a large intracellular beta 2-integrin precursor-pool can be correlated with altered integrin-mediated cell adhesion.

the size of an intracellular precursor pool of the beta 3-integrin sub-unit regulates the maturation of beta- and alpha- integrins, and that this pool is frequently found in malignant cells and can be used as a marker for the malignant transformation of cells.

the intracellular pool of the beta 3-integrin precursor regulates the maturation of beta-integrins and associated alpha-sub-units and that this regulation is important for integrin-mediated cell adhesion and cell migration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of an internal pool of pre-beta integrin subunit in the maturation of the integrin receptor.
the role of the intracellular pool of the beta 2-integrin sub-unit in the maturation process of beta 2-integration receptors.
the role of an intra-cellular pool of beta 1 integrin precursors for integrin receptor function and cell adhesion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the size of the intracellualar pool of beta 1 integrin precursor subunits regulates the maturation of the subunit and associated subunits and that this regulation has an impact on cell surface receptor function.
a decrease in the intracellular pool of beta 1 integrins may lead to a decrease in integrin receptor synthesis and maturation.
the size of the intracelular beta 1-integriin pool is important for integrin maturation, and that the intracellular beta1-integrin is a regulatory factor for integrin function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the size of the pre-beta integrin pool is important for integrin maturation and that the maturation process is regulated by the amount of beta 2-integrins synthesized.
a large pool of pre-beta1-integrin is a prerequisite for efficient integrin maturation and receptor function.
the intracellular beta1-integrin pre-protein pool is important for integrin function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a large pool of pre-beta1-integrin may be important for integrin function.
the size of the pool of intracellular pre-beta1 integrin regulates the maturation and function of beta1 integrin.

the size of the pre-beta1-integrin intracellular pool regulates the maturation of both the beta and the alpha-subunit and that a large intracellular pool may be required to maintain integrin function.
